# Recipes

<!-- This page is generated by scripts/generate-recipes.py from recipes/recipes.jsonl. Do not edit it by hand. -->

Recipes are tested ways to serve Hub models on Amazon SageMaker AI with the Hugging Face Deep Learning Containers (DLCs). Each one pins the container, the instance, and the engine settings, and the ones measured on SageMaker come with the validation and benchmark results Hugging Face collected on a real endpoint. Pick a model, compare its recipes, and deploy one in a click from the AWS console, with the AWS CLI, or from Python.

50 models and 243 recipes, 24 of them measured on SageMaker. Read [How recipes are measured](./methodology) for the workloads and metrics, and [Deploy a recipe](./deploy-a-recipe) for a step-by-step walkthrough.
